title: Averaged-Cost Control with Shared Feedback under Model Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2611.19019v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper studies the shared-feedback design problem for finite-horizon averaged-cost control under model uncertainty represented by a joint law over the model parameter and initial state. One feedback map is shared across all realizations and uses only time and the current state as online inputs. We develop two methods: the nonlinear adjoint method combines forward closed-loop solves, backward adjoints, and joint-law policy gradients, while the linear moment method gives exact cost and gradient formulas for a homogeneous linear-quadratic design model by propagating conditional second moments. Numerical studies compare averaged and nominal designs for time-dependent neural feedback and static linear feedback in nonlinear Van der Pol and Stuart-Landau systems; the static gains are designed from oscillator linearizations and evaluated on the original nonlinear systems. Averaged design has lower cost in most comparisons.

translated_title: 模型不确定性下基于共享反馈的平均代价控制
translated_abstract: 本文研究有限时域平均代价控制中的共享反馈设计问题，其中模型不确定性由模型参数与初始状态的联合分布律来表示。一个反馈映射在所有模型实现中共享，且在线运行时仅使用时间和当前状态作为输入。我们提出了两种方法：非线性伴随方法结合了前向闭环求解、后向伴随方程以及联合分布律下的策略梯度；线性矩方法则通过传播条件二阶矩，为齐次线性二次设计模型给出了精确的代价与梯度公式。数值研究在非线性范德波尔系统和Stuart-Landau系统中，比较了平均设计与标称设计在时变神经反馈和静态线性反馈下的表现；其中静态增益由振子线性化设计得到，并在原始非线性系统上进行评估。结果表明，平均设计在大多数比较中具有更低的代价。
tldr: 本文针对模型不确定性下的有限时域平均代价控制问题，提出了在所有模型实现间共享的反馈设计方法，开发了非线性伴随方法与线性矩方法两种求解途径，并通过数值实验证明平均设计在大多数情况下优于标称设计。
en_tdlr: This paper develops shared-feedback design methods—namely a nonlinear adjoint method and a linear moment method—for finite-horizon averaged-cost control under model uncertainty, demonstrating numerically that averaged designs achieve lower cost than nominal designs in most comparisons.
